source: Mobbin (iOS), researched 2026-11-17 for the Digi paywall + onboarding redesign

refs.steal: Fanned stack of real output photos as hero, sheet below, two radio plan cards: '$89.98 / year' big + '$1.72/week' small grey, 'Save 65%' tab on the card corner, one full-width CTA, one line of renewal text.
Dark 'How your free trial works' with ONE accent-coloured word in the headline and a vertical timeline (Today / Day 2 reminder / Day 3 charged) in the brand colour; neon pill CTA.
Timeline that prints the REAL charge date ('You'll be charged on September 1, cancel anytime before') plus price line 'First 14 days free, then $69.99' right under the title.
Camera-app bento grid of feature tiles drawn as camera UI (dials, histogram, PRO badge) around the app icon; quiet 'Try for free' + 'View all options' instead of a wall of prices.
Carousel of real AI results with a lens-picker dial underneath, dark glass feature rows with line icons + one-line subtitle, gradient-glow outline on the CTA.
Swipeable phone-mockup carousel with page dots on black, three horizontal plan tiles with the picked one in white + '-60%' tag, coloured glow under the white CTA; Restore top-left, close top-right.
Laurel-wreath badges ('App Store App of the Year', '5 stars 165K+') above a frosted-glass trial timeline; sticky CTA with plain price line 'Try 7 days free, then $54.99/year'.
Horizontal review cards (bold 3-word title + 1 line + avatar + stars) and a bell line under the CTA: 'We'll notify you 24h before your trial ends!'.

Out-of-credits sheet: two big-number pack cards (5 / 15 videos, 'Best deal' on the bigger one), 'or' divider, then a subscription row with '10 free videos included' pill. Model for Party Pack vs Plus.
Short 5-row table where the paid column is a raised gradient pill with a '76% users' choice' bubble on top; free column plain. Only 5 rows.
Man / Woman / Non-binary / Prefer not to say as full-width filled tiles, selected = inverted; one line saying WHY it's asked and 'won't appear on your profile'.
2x3 grid of square emoji tiles with 2-line labels, gradient progress bar on top, casual helper line 'All good if it changes', incl. a 'Still figuring it out' option.

also_seen.note: Closest-category camera app: dark, single gold accent, bottom sheet over feature list, yearly card shows full billed price.
Pack cards with 'Most Popular' / 'Save 25%' pills and per-unit price; 'never expire' copy.
Dark outlined answer cards with accent-colour title + grey descriptor.
ANTI-PATTERN: 'Enable free trial' toggles (Apple 3.1.2 rejects these).
ANTI-PATTERN: per-month price ($3.33/mo) bigger than the billed amount.
